brewspage.title: Coding Community & Continual Education
brewspage.description: The coding community is a powerful force for learning, growth, and innovation. Continual education keeps us sharp and ready for new challenges.

solid.title: SOLID Principles
content: SOLID is a set of design principles that help developers write maintainable and scalable code.
Each principle helps you build better software.

triple.title: Triple Constraint
content: The Triple Constraint is a project management concept: Scope, Time, Cost.
Balancing these three factors is key to successful project delivery.

bigo.title: Big O
content: Big O notation describes the performance of algorithms.
It helps you analyze time and space complexity.
Understanding Big O is essential for writing efficient code.

intro.title: Intro to Code Roast
intro.whatIsDesc: At Code Roast, we believe mastery comes from small, strong doses of insight — ideas that wake you up, not wear you out. Every concept, rule, and model we share is distilled to spark thought, fuel discussion, and strengthen your craft.
intro.typesRules: Rules: The boundaries that guide great systems.
intro.typesPrinciples: Principles: The timeless truths behind solid design.
intro.typesMethods: Methods: The repeatable ways to turn ideas into outcomes.
intro.typesFrameworks: Frameworks: The structures that keep teams aligned and code resilient.
intro.keyCoding: Code: The craft of building logic that lasts.
intro.keyData: Data: The foundation of every good decision.
intro.keyBusiness: Business: Where principles meet practice, and value is brewed.
intro.keyCulture: Community: A shared table for thinkers, makers, and mentors.

roasts.title: Roasts: Where Curiosity Meets Craft
roasts.understandingDesc: Real learning is iterative — test, taste, refine. Code Roast embraces this process with short, deep explorations called Brews, each designed to sharpen your thinking and expand your mental models.
roasts.coreConcepts: Concepts: Start with a spark — the big idea behind the method.
roasts.coreContext: Context: See where it fits, from clean code to agile strategy.
roasts.coreConnection: Connection: Link principles across disciplines to build stronger intuition.
roasts.coreCreation: Creation: Apply what you learn — build, break, and iterate.
roasts.vsTraditional: Traditional Learning: Long, linear, and often disconnected.
roasts.vsBI: Code Roast: Compact, contextual, and community-driven.
roasts.keyBrews: Brews: Bite-sized lessons with real-world grounding.
roasts.keyDeepDives: Deep Dives: Extended explorations with visuals, videos, and code.
roasts.keyCommunity: Community: Share your takeaways, challenge ideas, and grow together.

about.title: Our Story & Purpose
about.missionDesc: Code Roast started as a small side project between coders who believed that great learning should be strong, accessible, and shareable — like a good cup of coffee. Now, it’s a growing community that celebrates curiosity, critical thinking, and craft.
about.valuesCuriosity: Curiosity: Every bug, business rule, and theory is a chance to learn.
about.valuesCraft: Craft: We care about how things are built — from systems to sentences.
about.valuesClarity: Clarity: Simplicity isn’t easy — it’s the ultimate design goal.
about.valuesCommunity: Community: We grow faster when we share ideas and caffeine.
about.howWeWorkCollaborate: Collaborate: Discuss, debate, and refine your understanding.
about.howWeWorkContribute: Contribute: Write Brews, share frameworks, or host sessions.
about.howWeWorkCreate: Create: Turn insights into projects, papers, and real progress.
about.invitationDesc: Whether you’re a developer, data analyst, or product thinker — Code Roast is a space to learn, share, and caffeinate your curiosity. Grab a Brew and join the conversation.

contact.title: Get Caffeinated: Connect With Us
contact.description: Ready to fuel your next project? Whether you need a SaaS MVP, a code review, or just want to talk shop over coffee, Code Roast is here for you.

brews.title: Brews: What is a Brew?
brews.subTitle: A Brew is a compact learning experience designed to grow your skills, refresh your knowledge, and spark exploration of deeper concepts you can use every day.
brews.explanation: We don’t all have time for lengthy courses, so our Brews are crafted to spark your curiosity — covering the topics that matter most, from development and data science to business and project management.
